evidence.title: Stok Görseller, Royalty-Free Görseller, İllüstrasyonlar, Vektörler ve Videolar - iStock

name: iStock
summary: Stock media marketplace; the freeimages.com domain now redirects to iStock's photos, vectors, illustrations and videos.
description: iStock sells royalty-free stock photos, HD and 4K video, vectors and illustrations with plans and pricing, and gives away a free photo of the week plus a free illustration and video clip each month. Requests to freeimages.com redirect to iStock (our crawl landed on its Turkish locale); no separate freeimages catalog remains. The archive states it accepts no AI-generated content.
contains: stock photos, HD and 4K video, vectors and illustrations
free photo of the week, free illustration and free video clip of the month
